name: 485-x Affordable Neighborhoods for New Yorkers: Registrations of Prospective Applicants for Tax Benefits
description:
This dataset contains 472 records of registrations filed by prospective applicants for New York City's 485-x affordable housing tax benefit program. Each row represents a proposed residential development project and includes the property address, borough, tax block and lot, building identification number, permit sequence, and geographic identifiers such as latitude, longitude, community board, council district, census tract, and neighborhood tabulation area. Records also capture project details including total reported units, restricted affordable units, affordability option selected, commencement and anticipated dates, and submission date. Administrative fields provide presumed building and restricted unit counts, a presumed BBL, and duplicate flags with duplicate counts for records that appear more than once.

The data covers all five boroughs, with the largest share of registrations in the Bronx (about 46%), followed by Brooklyn (34%), Queens (17%), Manhattan (4%), and Staten Island (under 1%). Most projects selected Option B (91%), and reported unit counts range from 3 to 792
